args.sql:
SELECT tr."tr_anchor", 
       COUNT(*) as total_trades,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ce."evt_near" != 'None' AND ce."evt_near" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as event_linked_trades
FROM trade_records tr 
JOIN corporate_events ce ON tr."REC_KEY" = ce."REC_EVT"
GROUP BY tr."tr_anchor"
LIMIT 10;

SELECT tr."tr_anchor", COUNT(*) as total_trades
FROM trade_records tr 
GROUP BY tr."tr_anchor"
ORDER BY total_trades DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT tr."tr_anchor", 
       COUNT(*) as total_trades,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ce."evt_near" != 'None' AND ce."evt_near" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as event_linked_trades,
       CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN ce."evt_near" != 'None' AND ce."evt_near" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) as pct_event_linked
FROM trade_records tr 
JOIN corporate_events ce ON tr."REC_KEY" = ce."REC_EVT"
GROUP BY tr."tr_anchor"
HAVING CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN ce."evt_near" != 'None' AND ce."evt_near" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) > 0.30
ORDER BY pct_event_linked DESC;

SELECT t."TR_KEY"
FROM traders t
WHERE t."trader_fin_data"::json->>'risk_lvl' = 'Aggressive'
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM trade_records tr
    JOIN corporate_events ce ON tr."REC_KEY" = ce."REC_EVT"
    WHERE tr."tr_anchor" = t."TR_KEY"
    GROUP BY tr."tr_anchor"
    HAVING CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN ce."evt_near" != 'None' AND ce."evt_near" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) > 0.30
);

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
    SELECT t."TR_KEY"

    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
